tools.name: get_clinic_contact_info
tools.description: Returns the contact details of Quartz Clinique (plastic, reconstructive and aesthetic surgery and dermatology clinic in Nişantaşı, Şişli, Istanbul): phone, WhatsApp, e-mail, address, Google Maps link, opening hours, languages spoken and the contact page in each language.

tools.name: get_service_details
tools.description: Returns details about one treatment offered by Quartz Clinique: its page URL, Turkish and English name, the summary written by the clinic, the page in other languages (en, ar, de, fr, ru) when available, and how to contact the clinic about it. Use list_services to find the id.

service.description: The service id from list_services, e.g. "burun-estetigi" (rhinoplasty), "liposuction", "vaser-liposuction", "meme-estetigi" (breast aesthetics), "botox".

tools.name: list_doctors
tools.description: Lists the doctors of Quartz Clinique (founder Op. Dr. Leyla Arvas, plastic, reconstructive and aesthetic surgeon, and the medical aesthetics physician) with their profile page, a short summary and the profile pages in other languages.

tools.name: list_services
tools.description: Lists the treatments offered by Quartz Clinique in Istanbul: facial, body and breast aesthetic surgery, non-surgical medical aesthetics (botox, fillers, thread lifts, PRP, mesotherapy), device treatments (Thermage, Ulthera, HIFU, lasers), dermatology and hair transplant. Each result has an id (use it with get_service_details), Turkish and English name, category and page URL. Filter by category and/or a free-text query in Turkish or English.

category.description: Optional category id, e.g. "yuz-estetigi" (facial surgery), "vucut-estetigi" (body and breast surgery), "medikal-estetik" (non-surgical and device treatments), "dermatoloji" (dermatology), "sac-ekimi" (hair transplant). Call without arguments to get all categories.

query.description: Optional search text matched against Turkish and English treatment names, e.g. "rhinoplasty", "burun", "liposuction", "botox", "hair transplant".

tools.name: search_site
tools.description: Search the Quartz Clinique website (treatments, doctors and articles) and open the results page.
